edge_cases: When the bounds are equal the answer is that value. A range spanning a power of two yields zero in the bits below it.
input_semantics: Two parameters, left and right, giving the inclusive bounds of the range with left no greater than right.
load_bearing: Every integer in the range participates, and the operation applied across them is bitwise AND.
output_semantics: A single integer: the bitwise AND of all integers from left to right inclusive.
required_operation: Compute the bitwise AND of every integer in an inclusive range, and report the result.
